== Summary ==

Extracted from the embedded card photograph on p. 45, xref 2077, without modifying the image bytes.<ref name="japanese-chewie">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Image SHA-256: <code>f7bd051daa638238e77065902948b8ccfec3731b6484e5dfeb19fc869905b305</code>. The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
